snippet.title: PS3 Longplay [116] Jeopardy (2 Player)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Spazbo4 & Ironsharp

This was a terrible idea, the game hardly wanted to connect and when we finally were able to play sometimes we would mess up on typing and hit square which is normally backspace but in this game it is accept which messed us up a few times.

Also during the final question of the first game we did we thought it was hilarious how the lady never left and was floating there, even during the credits. -
